title: I gave Claude Code one prompt and a song. It staged, shot and cut this trailer inside my game.
author: MightyBig-Dev
selftext:
Yesterday I shared the Rope Ninja trailer. Same pipeline, different game: Drop Dead, a ball-drop battle royale for phones.

My input was one prompt, a Suno song, and one paragraph of notes on the first cut. Claude Code did everything else.

It doesn't screen-record anything. It runs the real game in a headless browser on a paused clock and steps it one frame at a time, so every take comes out identical. It stages its own shots, jumping to later rounds and searching random seeds until the game plays out the moment it wants. The sound effects are the game's own, logged and rebuilt in sync, the cuts land on the beat, and the captions use the game's fonts and icons.

Take 1 was too frantic. I said so in one paragraph, and take 2 (this one) came back in under an hour.

Play it free: [dropdead.mightybig.ca](http://dropdead.mightybig.ca)
